intro: Warsong Runner Update is a Horde communication task connecting the forward defenses of Ashenvale with commanders along the border. Entrusted to couriers and fresh recruits, the missive details the rising military pressure facing Warsong scouts, notably the aggression of encroaching naga.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.
You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, friend. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.
But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
